title: Stars, cars and highlights from the 2026 Goodwood Revival
extract: The 2026 Goodwood Revival brought together historic Le Mans winners, Formula 1 machinery and unusual cars, including reunited Ford GT40s, a rare Alfa Romeo 8C and a unique Lotus Elite project.

title: McLaren unveils a revised brand identity linking Racing and Automotive
extract: McLaren has refreshed its visual identity with a revised wordmark inspired by Bruce McLaren's New Zealand roots, bringing its racing and automotive businesses under a more unified design language.

title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
extract: Formula 1 has agreed in principle to reduce standard Grand Prix distance for 2027 as the sport prepares for revised power units with more combustion-engine output and less electrical power.

title: Red Bull admits Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027
extract: Red Bull says a persistent problem with Max Verstappen's 2026 car cannot be completely resolved until the next rules cycle, highlighting the technical compromises behind the current design.

title: Sebastian Vettel says F1 must combine the things fans love with a sustainable future
extract: Sebastian Vettel argues that Formula 1 should preserve the elements enthusiasts value while adapting its technical and sporting direction for greater sustainability.

title: David Coulthard calls for changes to Madrid's Madring before its 2027 return
extract: David Coulthard has called for changes to Madrid's new Madring circuit before Formula 1 returns in 2027, focusing attention on the track's overtaking characteristics.

title: D-Link warns of a maximum-severity zero-day in DIR-822A routers
extract: D-Link has warned of an unpatched maximum-severity stack-based buffer overflow in legacy DIR-822A routers, with public proof-of-concept exploit code available.

title: New ClosedQuorum Windows malware uses AI for attack decisions
extract: Researchers have identified Windows malware that uses Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and Mistral models to make autonomous decisions about its actions, illustrating a new class of AI-integrated threats.

title: OpenTelemetry support arrives in the GitHub Copilot app
extract: The GitHub Copilot app now supports OpenTelemetry configuration through enterprise-managed settings, allowing organisations to trace agent activity and tool interactions through compatible observability systems.

title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains gains agent approvals, plans and persistent MCP controls
extract: Copilot for JetBrains 1.18.0 adds assisted tool approvals, agent plan mode, shared skills and instructions, and persistent controls for MCP tools.

title: Open-source Nouveau driver gets HDMI Deep Color patches
extract: New patches for the open-source NVIDIA Nouveau driver add HDMI Deep Color support, including 10-, 12- and 16-bit-per-channel RGB output, although some capabilities remain untested.

title: Alibaba contributes $3 million to Omarchy for an agentic Linux OS
extract: Alibaba Cloud is contributing $3 million to the Omacom Foundation over three years to help develop Omarchy and work towards a Linux desktop designed for people and AI agents to work together.

title: Mike Battilana presents Amiga history and development at Saku 2026
extract: Amiga Corporation's Mike Battilana gave a presentation at the Saku 2026 Amiga meeting in Finland, providing a new video record of the community event and its historical discussion.

title: Fliegeralarms Wintergames brings five winter sports to the Amiga 1200
extract: A new free Amiga 1200 game from Fliegeralarm Games offers five winter sports disciplines, four-player hotseat play, 256-colour graphics and copper effects as part of AmiGameJam 9.

title: hURL 2.2 brings modern HTTPS and file-transfer support to Amiga systems
extract: The hURL plugin has been updated across AmigaOS 3, AmigaOS 4, MorphOS and other platforms, providing command-line URL and transfer capabilities with platform-specific SSL support.

title: AmiMAIL 2.0.6 updates email support for AmigaOS 3.2 and 4
extract: Andreas Stürmer has updated AmiMAIL, an IMAP and SMTP client for AmigaOS 3.2 that also runs on AmigaOS 4, with a new maintenance release.

title: Copperline 0.21.0 improves the Rust Amiga emulator
extract: Copperline 0.21.0 adds spectators to netplay, supports four local controllers on desktop and RetroArch, reduces frame-display work and fixes file-picker crashes.

title: The Sinclair Spectrum gets a desktop GUI
extract: ZXdesk is an assembly-language project that gives a 48K ZX Spectrum a GEM-like desktop with menus, windows and built-in applications, pushing the original hardware far beyond its normal interface.

title: Tiny Quest receives an Amstrad CPC port after a multi-system source conversion effort
extract: Outsoftware has ported the C64 platformer Tiny Quest to the Amstrad CPC after working through source conversions for more than 30 projects targeting underserved classic systems.

title: Roland&Mej Build brings a new Amstrad CPC homebrew adventure
extract: The Qproyect has released Roland&Mej Build, a new Amstrad CPC adventure platformer in which two characters act as technology spies investigating the classic computer industry.

title: Flashback is being brought to the Atari ST through a modern engine port
extract: Neil Rackett is porting the REminiscence engine to Atari ST hardware to finally give the machine a version of Flashback, with optimised frame rates and display modes for different ST models.

title: BitBinders recreates and modernises hardware for Commodore and Amiga systems
extract: A VCF Midwest interview with BitBinders covers replacement power supplies, recreated 1581 drives, dual-drive enclosures, a MEGA65 companion drive and a mechanical Amiga 1200 keyboard.

title: Mint Software pushes modern media capabilities onto the Amiga 1200
extract: A new demonstration shows MintAMP, MintPRINT, MintSCAN and MintVID connecting an accelerated Amiga 1200 to modern media, network and online services while exposing the limits of classic hardware.

title: Shaderjoy 1.27 adds direct Mesa selection on AmigaOS 4
extract: Shaderjoy 1.27 revises OpenGL handling on AmigaOS 4 and adds a MESA tooltype so users can select Mesa directly when the standard Ogles2 graphics path causes compatibility problems.

title: Panerai introduces three smaller 42mm Luminor references
extract: Panerai has introduced three 42mm Luminor models inspired by its pre-Vendome design heritage, bringing the historic cushion case and crown-protection architecture to a smaller and more accessible format.

title: Panerai Luminor 42mm models explored in detail
extract: Fratello examines Panerai's new 42mm Luminor references, including the PAM01710, PAM01711 and black DLC PAM01714, and their relationship to the brand's historic designs.

title: Vacheron Constantin and The Met unveil three new artisan works
extract: Vacheron Constantin and The Metropolitan Museum of Art have unveiled three new works created through their artisan residency programme, continuing a collaboration between contemporary artists and high horology.

title: Louis Vuitton adds bold colour to the Tambour Spin Time collection
extract: Louis Vuitton has expanded the Tambour Spin Time family with a more colourful new collection, extending the distinctive rotating-hour complication into a fresh set of designs.

title: MB&F's recent releases get a closer look
extract: Haute Time reviews the latest MB&F releases and the independent brand's continuing approach to unusual cases, mechanical displays and unconventional horological design.

title: Taylor Swift to receive inaugural MTV VMA Artist Director Honors
extract: Taylor Swift will receive the first MTV VMA Artist Director Honors at the 2026 awards, recognising a sustained body of work and an artist's directorial voice.

title: CHVRCHES return with new single Roses and London and Glasgow shows
extract: CHVRCHES have returned with Roses, a dark new single, alongside intimate Glasgow and London shows marking the band's latest chapter.

title: Patrick Wolf plans an orchestral celebration of The Magic Position
extract: Patrick Wolf will mark 20 years of The Magic Position with a one-night orchestral London performance designed as a major live reinterpretation of the album.

title: Echo & The Bunnymen announce a 2026 winter UK tour
extract: Echo & The Bunnymen have announced new UK winter dates, with tickets scheduled to go on sale on September 24.

title: Razorlight's Andy Burrows announces new solo album Map Of The World
extract: Andy Burrows has announced Map Of The World, his first solo album in seven years, alongside the new single Nothing Matters Anyway and collaborations with musicians including Nicky Wire and Tom Smith.

title: Apple is opening its first live music venue beneath Battersea Power Station
extract: Apple will open a 600-seat live music venue at its European headquarters in Battersea Power Station, with a 48-speaker spatial audio system and facilities for recording and broadcasting performances.

title: The Big Bad Book of Kaiju arrives with 25 new monster stories
extract: Jonathan Maberry and Henry Herz have edited a new anthology of 25 original science-fiction and horror stories about giant monsters, bringing together established and emerging genre writers.

title: The Strangers brings intelligent mystery animals into Naomi Alderman's new novel
extract: Naomi Alderman's new speculative novel The Strangers follows the spread of mysterious intelligent animals called mimmoths and the conspiracy theories and global power struggles that grow around them.

title: A new September speculative-fiction release cycle arrives
extract: A detailed September speculative-fiction feature examines the week's new releases, including science fiction, fantasy and horror titles such as Mazywood, Incarnate and The Henchperson's Guide to Unionizing.

title: Porchlight highlights new books about AI and climate change
extract: Porchlight's latest new-release selection focuses on books examining the changing climate, artificial intelligence and other major technological and environmental questions.

title: Dead Beat reviewed as Leigh Bardugo's Ninth House finale
source: The Good, The Bad and The Unread
extract: A new review examines Dead Beat, Leigh Bardugo's third Ninth House novel, describing its dark-academia fantasy setting and its role as the conclusion to the series.

title: Daredevil: Born Again will end with its third season
extract: Marvel's Daredevil: Born Again is expected to conclude with its third season, according to sources, after filming for the season finished and its previous showrunner departed during post-production.

title: Coyote vs. Acme finally reaches cinemas after years in limbo
extract: The Looney Tunes hybrid Coyote vs. Acme is now in cinemas after Warner Bros. had previously shelved the completed film, with the release blending live action, digital effects and classic cartoon characters.

title: Star Trek news roundup covers Year One uncertainty and Strange New Worlds
extract: A new Star Trek roundup covers the uncertain status of the proposed Year One series, the approach to Strange New Worlds season four and the franchise's wider 60th-anniversary activity.

title: Sherlock Holmes producer June Wyndham Davies dies aged 97
extract: June Wyndham Davies, who produced Granada Television's acclaimed Sherlock Holmes adaptations starring Jeremy Brett, has died aged 97 after a long career in British television.

title: Wil Wheaton recalls how Stand by Me led to Star Trek
extract: Wil Wheaton has discussed how his role in Stand by Me helped lead to his casting as Wesley Crusher in Star Trek: The Next Generation during a 40th-anniversary conversation about the film.

title: Angel's Egg arrives on 4K with new archival extras
extract: Mamoru Oshii's surreal animated classic Angel's Egg receives a new 4K release with interviews, artwork and archival material accompanying the restored film.
